thread.title: Apple’s HomePod; First Foray into Speaker Market

author: Jill King
title: Apple’s HomePod; First Foray into Speaker Market
text:
February 11, 2018 Apple’s HomePod; First Foray into Speaker Market 
Apple’s HomePod is first foray into the speaker market, as it came with “Siri voice assistant” built in, the device is priced at $350 response to the Google Home and Amazon Echo and it’s made only for the “iPhone” and “iPad” users. Bad news for Android phone users, this offer isn’t for them. 
Homepod’s audio performance is perfect, and it is superior to that of its competitors, if we look at “Siri” it isn’t as smart as Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, but if audio in your primary concern, then you can save a ton of money by buying a Sonos. 
The device has Siri inside, hence we are able to ask for the weather, the time of next basketball game and can also add notes to iPhone. Homepod can also compose and send the text messages and having enough intelligence to give us a daily news briefing.
